title: unified-rollouts: probing staged shadow canary auto-rollback enhancements
author: Priya Natarajan
release_notes: Enhances probing/staged shadow canary auto-rollback workflows: improved metric matching, safety guards, and observability hooks. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: We observed intermittent regression rollouts where metric noise and short-lived probing traffic caused unnecessary rollbacks during staged shadow canary experiments. This PR improves resilience by adding a probing/stage-aware aggregation window, composite metric smoothing, and a safety guard to require sustained signal across multiple dimensions before triggering an automatic rollback.

Summary of changes: - Add 'probing_window' and 'stage_weight' configuration props to rollout policies to better separate low-sample probing traffic from production-canary signal. - Implement composite metric smoothing (exponential moving average with configurable alpha) and require cross-metric agreement for rollback decisions. - Introduce a cooldown period and minimum sample threshold before an auto-rollback can execute. - Add tracing hooks and structured events to the rollout controller so the Console and alerting can surface probe vs production decisions. - Add e2e and unit tests for the rollback decision path and upgrade migration script to set sane defaults for existing rollout configs.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-1429) - [x] Unit tests added for decision engine - [x] Integration tests for staged shadow flows - [x] Observability metrics and tracing added - [x] Migration script included

Testing and validation: Local unit tests and integration harness exercise multi-stage canary + shadow flows. Ran the perf-canary harness against a canary workload (1M tokens) to check latency impact; observed <1% P50 regression. e2e tests simulate probe traffic (low-sample bursts) to verify no false-positive rollbacks. CI: build, lint, unit, integration, e2e passed after two flake retries.

Backward compatibility and rollout plan: Configuration is additive. The migration script populates default 'probing_window' and 'min_samples' for existing rollouts to preserve current behavior. Rollout plan: merge to main, staged rollout to prod region-1 for 48h with telemetry checks, then global. Emergency rollback: standard manual rollback path still available.

Related: PRs #91234, #103210 and linked Linear ENG-1429.

Files changed (high-level): rollout/controller/decision_engine.py, rollout/policies/probing.py, rollout/api/v1/schemas.py, rollout/migrations/2026_02_add_probing_fields.sql, observability/trace_hooks.py, console/rollout_ui/metrics_panel.tsx, tests/integration/test_probing_rollouts.py, tests/unit/test_ema_smoothing.py

merge_message:
Squash and merge: probing staged shadow canary auto-rollback enhancements

Adds probing window, EMA smoothing, cooldown and observability hooks to reduce false-positive autorollbacks during low-sample probe traffic.
notes_for_release: Defaults are safe; migration script will populate new fields. Ops: watch rollout.rollout_auto_rollback events and rollout.probe_sample_count metric. Recommend 48h staged rollout in region-1 and ensure alerts for rollout.auto_rollback_triggered are enabled.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: changes are guarded by thresholds and min-sample requirements. Main risk is mis-configured thresholds causing delayed rollback; defaults chosen conservatively.
